literal: In prosperity is required humility; in small adversity is required loftiness.
translation: In times of great prosperity, humility is required; in times of diminished fortune, maintaining one's dignity and loftiness of mind is required.
modern: செல்வம் பெருகிய காலத்தில் பணிவுடன் இருக்க வேண்டும்; வறுமையால் வாழ்வு சுருங்கிய காலத்தில் மானத்தோடு கூடிய உயர்வான எண்ணத்தைக் கொண்டிருக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the ideal conduct of a person of high character during the changing tides of fortune. In times of great prosperity, one must practice humility to avoid arrogance and show respect to others. Conversely, when one's circumstances are reduced or diminished, one must maintain high self-esteem and dignity rather than begging or losing self-respect. The contrast between humility in wealth and dignity in poverty highlights the true essence of honour.
